since_3be8fb60.diff: 31 changed lines (19 additions, 12 deletions), only import/AppShell regions substitutions from 01ed92ca9. Home painters, simulation tag projections and input routing remain unchanged.

findings.finding: The scenario/tag view chain calls paint_parity_discovery and returns before NavList.draw. The rendered rows therefore do not use the NavListState or register the real list controls. update still runs NavList.update over HomeRow data at lines 186-208. The static TagRow.selected and preview data are independent of actual selection/filtering.

Nine production *_tag_frame selectors switch presentation/catalogue at scenario plus now_ms()==80, while parity_discovery uses scenario plus now_ms()>=80. FinderLine/TagRow/PreviewLine tables encode headings, blanks, chips, selected state, fixed metadata and preview values. This is a reference-screen projection in the simulation helper, not ordinary simulation source state. Remove these projection selectors/data after semantic catalogues generate the same outcomes. Do not move the tables into Termrock.

Exact 80x24 and 100x30 plus tag-clock predicates select distinct activity bands; host/project/status/footer content also varies by tag predicates. MenuBar is repainted after shared rendering for disk-tag state. These are not general responsive policies.

Even the ordinary path supplies an application-owned raw row painter, draws its own focus gutter/column widths and then repaints section titles after the shared NavList has drawn. Header container and header text need independent shared styling; row content should use RowUi slots/columns.

Application-owned split_detail reproduces a master/detail calculation and private preview wrapping/scrollbar painting. Preview scrollbar creates a new ScrollState each draw, so it cannot own persistent scroll or drag interaction. Use the existing shared responsive master/detail and text/Props viewport contracts with one resolved layout.

Application draw writes ESC[6 q directly to stdout when Home and terminal stdout are active. Cursor shape must be declared by the real visible input through runtime ownership, not terminal-dependent side effects during draw.

App helper owns route/control/menu/modal sequencing, dynamic key binding mutation, activity strip hit registration and pointer activation. Shared widgets do provide some routing protection, so no background-interaction defect is asserted without execution, but the complete application dependency tree is not a thin composition consumer.

legitimate_paths.retain: Domain connection/task/Git/container data, ranking/business rules, dispatch and plan decisions stay application-owned.

Discovery schedules, simulated outcomes and clock advancement are legitimate scenario data. Do not remove ordinary schedules merely because they contain times. The separate tag-frame presentation projections are the defect.
historical_tests is cfg(test), not a production replay path.

Existing real Picker, Dialog, Props, TextViewport and List state/update/draw calls are useful. Preserve typed domain actions; migrate remaining manual component layout rather than restoring monolithic screens.
